title: YOLO12-MambaScan: An Efficient Object Detector with High-Frequency Enhancement and State-Space Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.13647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology has made aerial-image object detection increasingly important for natural-resource monitoring, traffic management, and disaster response. Detecting small objects in aerial images remains difficult because objects occupy very few pixels, high-frequency cues are easily lost, and global context is hard to model in cluttered scenes. Existing detectors often retain insufficient edge, corner, and texture information. We propose \ours, an aerial-image detector built on the YOLO12 architecture. The model combines a triple-path high-frequency enhancement convolution module (TriPathHFConv), receptive-field coordinate-attention convolution (RFCAConv), and a Mamba-based global-context module. On VisDrone, at an input resolution of 960*960, ours achieves 60.0% mAP@50 and 38.6%mAP@50:95, demonstrating a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off for small-object detection. The benchmark

translated_title: YOLO12-MambaScan：一种结合高频增强与状态空间建模的高效目标检测器
translated_abstract: 无人机（UAV）技术的快速发展使得航空图像目标检测在自然资源监测、交通管理和灾害响应等领域变得日益重要。由于目标仅占据极少的像素、高频线索容易丢失，且杂乱场景中的全局上下文难以建模，航空图像中的小目标检测仍然十分困难。现有检测器往往对边缘、角点和纹理信息的保留不足。我们提出了YOLO12-MambaScan，一个基于YOLO12架构构建的航空图像检测器。该模型结合了三路径高频增强卷积模块、感受野坐标注意力卷积模块以及基于Mamba的全局上下文模块。在VisDrone数据集上，输入分辨率为960×960时，该模型取得了60.0%的mAP@50和38.6%的mAP@50:95，在小目标检测方面展现出良好的精度与效率权衡。
tldr: 该论文提出基于YOLO12架构的航空图像小目标检测器YOLO12-MambaScan，通过融合三路径高频增强卷积、感受野坐标注意力和基于Mamba的全局上下文建模模块，在VisDrone数据集上实现了60.0%的mAP@50，兼顾了检测精度与效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes YOLO12-MambaScan, a YOLO12-based aerial image detector that integrates triple-path high-frequency enhancement convolution, receptive-field coordinate attention, and Mamba-based global-context modeling, achieving 60.0% mAP@50 on VisDrone with a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for small-object detection.
